fines.category.person: Traffic offences and court fines — bound to the person, not the vehicle
fines.consent.details: Only the plate is sent, with one request per check. The result is kept in memory only (30 min) and never sent to third parties. If you use the app for business purposes, you are the data controller under the Serbian data protection law. You can revoke consent in the settings.
fines.consent.text: Chitach will send the vehicle plate %s to the following official portals:
fines.consent.title: Automatic fines check
fines.payOnPortal: Fines are paid and disputed on the issuer's portal. For information only.
fines.plateCopiedHint: Paste it into the plate field on the portal.
fines.privacy: Chitach does not store this data. An automatic check sends only the plate, directly to the official portal.
fines.provider.bg-parking.name: Belgrade – Parking servis (eDPK)
fines.provider.bg-parking.note: eDPK tickets from the last 60 days. The page is protected by a human check — enter the plate yourself.
fines.provider.ca-parking.name: Čačak – Parking servis
fines.provider.ca-parking.note: Checked by ticket number, not by plate.
fines.provider.enp.name: Road toll – ENP / Toll4All account
fines.provider.enp.note: There is no public toll check by plate; passages and debts are shown in your TAG account.
fines.provider.euprava-prekrsaji.name: eUprava – Traffic offences overview
fines.provider.euprava-prekrsaji.note: Offences, penalty points and orders of the signed-in person. Sign in with ConsentID or the ID card certificate.
fines.provider.kg-sumadija.name: Kragujevac – JKP “Šumadija”
fines.provider.kg-sumadija.note: Check of daily parking tickets by plate. Supports the automatic check.
fines.provider.nis-parking.name: Niš – Parking servis (eDPK)
fines.provider.nis-parking.note: Menu “eDPK provera”, tickets from the last 60 days.
fines.provider.np-parking.name: Novi Pazar – Parking servis (ParkingNS portal)
fines.provider.np-parking.note: Electronic parking tickets by plate (e.g. NP123AB) on the ParkingNS portal. Supports the automatic check. Payment instructions only for tickets from the last year; the data is informative.
fines.provider.parkingns.name: Novi Sad – ParkingNS portal (ePPK)
fines.provider.parkingns.note: Electronic parking tickets by plate; reportedly used by other cities too. Supports the automatic check.
fines.provider.pk-parking.name: Prokuplje
fines.provider.rnk.name: Register of unpaid fines
fines.provider.rnk.note: Final unpaid fines. Requires name, surname and personal number — Chitach never sends them automatically.
fines.provider.zlatibor-parking.name: Zlatibor / Čajetina – KJP “Zlatibor” (eDPK)
fines.provider.zlatibor-parking.note: eDPK check by plate. Supports the automatic check.
fines.provider.zr-parking.name: Zrenjanin – JKP “Pijace i parkinzi” (ePPK)
fines.provider.zr-parking.note: Check of electronic parking tickets by plate. Supports the automatic check.
fines.statusHint.manual: The portal does not allow an automatic check — open it and check manually
fines.statusHint.parseError: The portal may have changed its response format — check manually
fines.statusHint.unavailable: The portal is not reachable right now, try again later
fines.subtitle: Official portals for checking unpaid parking tickets and other fines
fines.tip: For ongoing notifications use the parking operator's official app.
fines.title: Fines check
history.apiConfigured: Your key is stored. Only the VIN is sent to %s; each request is charged under your contract.
history.apiNotConfigured: For companies with their own contract: enter your API key in the settings and the report is shown here.

history.check.firstRegistration.new: First registered in the year of production or the year after — probably bought new.
history.check.make.match: Manufacturer from the VIN (%s) matches the card.
history.check.make.mismatch: Manufacturer from the VIN (%s) does not match the make on the card (%s).
history.check.make.unknownWmi: Manufacturer code %s is not in Chitach's table — it cannot be compared.
history.check.modelYear.match: Model year from the VIN (%s) matches the year of production.
history.check.modelYear.mismatch: Model year from the VIN (%s) differs from the year of production on the card (%s).
history.check.modelYear.notEncoded: This manufacturer does not encode the model year in the VIN.
history.check.vin.invalid: The VIN has %s characters instead of 17 (older vehicles may have shorter numbers).
history.check.vin.valid: The VIN format is valid (17 characters).
history.checksTitle: VIN check — on this computer, nothing is sent
history.consent.details: Only the VIN is sent, once per request, using your own API key. The provider charges the request under your contract. The result is kept in memory only (30 min). If you use the app for business, you are the data controller under Serbian data protection law. You can revoke consent in the settings.
history.consent.text: Chitach will send the VIN %s to:
history.consent.title: Vehicle history report
history.copiedHint: Paste it into the search field of the service.
history.hideUsa: Hide services for vehicles from North America
history.mileageNote: Mileage is not kept in a public register in Serbia — only commercial reports and foreign registers show it.
history.privacy: The VIN check runs on this computer. Links open the service's website; nothing is sent until you search there yourself.
history.provider.autodna.note: Damage, mileage, theft and service records from 26+ markets in Europe and North America.
history.provider.carfax-eu.note: Vehicle history from 20+ countries in Europe and North America.
history.provider.carvertical.note: Damage, mileage rollback, theft, photos and ownership history from many European databases. Serbian version.
history.provider.cebia.note: Mileage, damage and taxi history; strongest for vehicles from the Czech Republic and Slovakia.
history.provider.nhtsa-recalls.name: NHTSA – safety recalls
history.provider.nhtsa-recalls.note: Official US register of unrepaired safety recalls, opened with the VIN filled in.
history.provider.uos-carcheck.name: UOS CarCheck – Association of Serbian Insurers
history.provider.uos-carcheck.note: Free: year of production, first registration in Serbia and registration status. Paid by SMS: number of insurance claims, number of owners, colour change, taxi or leasing use. Mobile app only.
history.provider.vinaudit.note: US history (NMVTIS): title brands, salvage, mileage records.
history.provider.vincario.name: Vincario
history.provider.vincario.note: VIN decoding, stolen-vehicle check and market value.
history.providerData: Data as returned by %s, not checked by Chitach.
history.showUsa: Show services for vehicles from North America
history.subtitle: First registration, damage, mileage — what the card says and where to check the rest
history.title: Vehicle history

settings.finesConsentNotGivenDesc: It will be asked for before the first automatic check.

settings.finesProviderDesc: Automatic check — the plate is sent to %s
settings.finesRemoteDesc: Once a day, downloads the signed portal list from GitHub so new cities and fixes arrive without a new version. No personal data is sent.
settings.historyConsent: Sending the VIN to the history API
settings.historyConsentGivenDesc: The VIN is sent only when you request a report.
settings.historyConsentNotGivenDesc: You will be asked before the first report.
settings.historyDesc: Report in the app through a commercial API with your own key. The key is stored only on this computer, separately from the settings.
settings.historyKeyDesc: Your key and secret from the provider's account; the VIN is sent to %s
